material.description: CI run 39578210007 job 119149405387 at sha 0fd7d47: moba attack-move trace stays at pos=168.76,161.50 attacks=1 orders=6-7 for ~30 ticks, then Error hero neither travelled toward nor struck (dist 5.00->5.00). The same step passed at 24ac524 (dist 5.00->0.99). The only page change since is js/client/feedback.js, whose overlay uses pointer-events:none, so it cannot block clicks. Suspect timing flake in the probe; confirm on a re-run before changing the probe. Blocked by ci-browser-probe-steps-absent-blocker-drain-g-1: the probe steps this row names are not in main ci.yml (removed with the file at 129d0a4a), so no re-run of the probe is possible; the row stays pending until that blocker's owner decision lands.
material.resolution: Premise: the probe steps were removed with ci.yml at 129d0a4a (Remove the push-triggered test workflows) and not restored; 02a1139f (Restore push-triggered CI) recreated ci.yml with three jobs and no browser probe. Both shas are ancestors of origin/main. ci.yml on origin/main and in the working tree is 79 lines (later edits after 02a1139f), jobs push/workflow_dispatch/rust/wire/static, with zero occurrences of fxWait, remoteCasts, srflx, moba-input, cast_dropped.
